about: Retextures (GameData/overrides/textures) judged wrong in play, for tools/remaster_textures.py until they are regenerated (docs/retexture.md). Name (lower case) -> {use, why}: use 'original' keeps the original texture, 'exact' takes the texel-exact colour lock (only detail finer than one original texel stays, as pack v1 had it) instead of the low-frequency lock.
